meta.name: friction-retrospective
meta.description: Scan delivery artefacts for friction log entries, detect recurring patterns, and produce retrospective reports. Invoked by Discovery Agent (never by Delivery) to identify systemic improvement opportunities from friction captured during delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描交付记录，发现重复问题，生成回顾报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队在交付后需要系统性识别改进机会
copy.tagline_en: Scan delivery artifacts, detect patterns, and generate retrospective reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to identify systemic improvements after delivery

howto.what: Claude 会扫描交付产物中的摩擦日志，检测重复模式，生成包含模式总结、高信号事件候选和改进建议的回顾报告。
howto.when: 当 Discovery Agent 被调用时触发，典型时机包括：某个 Epic 标记完成、每月配合 memory-refresh、或单个 Story 产生 3 次以上摩擦事件。

say.text: 请对刚刚完成的 Epic-42 做一次摩擦回顾。
say.note: Claude 会扫描相关产物并生成回顾报告。

say.text: 分析这个月的所有摩擦日志，找出需要改进的模式。
say.note: Claude 按日期范围扫描并输出报告。

howto.what_en: Claude scans delivery artefacts for friction log entries, detects recurring patterns, and produces a retrospective report with pattern summary, high-signal event candidates, and recommended improvements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the Discovery Agent is invoked. Typical triggers: an Epic marked done, monthly alongside memory-refresh, or a single Story with 3+ friction events.

say_en.text: Run a friction retrospective for the completed Epic-42.
say_en.note: Claude scans relevant artefacts and generates a report.

say_en.text: Analyze this month's friction logs and identify patterns to improve.
say_en.note: Claude filters by date range and outputs the report.
